changelog: 1.0.0.0: globes built in the admin page from libraries, artwork types and a sort, each with its own rating limit, folders, black bars and picture fit; turned and zoomed like a map; opened from a globe button in the header, switched in a side menu, closed with X, Esc or Back; a double-click opens a title, plays it, its trailer or a photo, as a table per media type sets; animated artwork plays over its tile; updates by hand or by the task Build Globe, and the storage can be compacted.
description: Shows the artwork of your libraries on globes you can turn and zoom; a double-click opens the title.
name: Globe
overview: Turn and zoom through the posters, fanart, logos and discs of your libraries on globes.
